about_the_game:
This is a cute, fresh-styled, casual asymmetric Furry mini game!

No scary sound effects or horror vibes—just pure lighthearted fun, cuteness, and delightful nonsense QwQ.

Players can take on the role of adorable furry characters, teaming up with three others to evade and escape the gooey tentacle monster! Furries must search the map for escape items, carefully avoiding the monster while solving playful puzzles to unlock them. Failed attempts come with a tiny, silly penalty w—but don’t worry, plenty of helpful supplies are scattered around to bounce back!

The Boss player controls the squishy tentacle creature, aiming to catch all Furries players and stop them from collecting items and escaping. The Boss can attack with claw swipes, grab players with stretchy tentacles, or throw goo balls to slow them down. Once caught, Furries are placed into goo traps to slowly "gelatinize" prpr~

Between escapes, Furries can dance, take photos with a built-in camera, find weapons for self-defense, or locate rescue items to help teammates!

⚠Warning⚠

This game features anthropomorphic fantasy animal characters in a cartoon style. Some characters are depicted without clothing, but no genitalia are shown. For characters with more pronounced sexual characteristics, clothing has been used to cover these areas, and they are not presented in a sexualized manner!

Gameplay includes scenes where characters are restrained by gel-like tentacles and subjected to tickling. Characters will exhibit struggling movements and audible gasping reactions.

Note: This game is in early development. You may frequently meet digital bugs (literally!). If you encounter a reproducible or game-breaking bug, please email 笨笨Bon&CrazyDog via the "About" tab in the main menu. We’ll fix it ASAP!

P.S. If you have a personal, non-commercial 3D Furry character model, you’re welcome to send it to us (via the in-game contact option) to be added to the game for free! We’d love to include more unique critters in our cozy world!

short_description: A cute, lighthearted asymmetric furry mini-game! Four players act as Furries collecting items to escape, while one plays a gooey tentacle monster using claws, grabs, and slime balls to trap them. Enjoy fun props, rescues, dances, photos, and silly battles—bringing laughter and cozy joy!
